cohort: 2,135 women who gave birth in one of 23 French maternity units in 2019
finding: Vaginal delivery and satisfactory medical management were the main factors associated with a positive birth experience, while epidural analgesia was associated with an increased feeling of failure.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was strongly associated with a positive birth experience, while cesarean delivery and operative vaginal delivery were associated with a poor experience.
